build_DETR_model: build a DETR 3D object detection model with backbone, transformer, and query embeddings
run_DETR_forward: run the DETR model forward pass on a NestedTensor to get predicted logits and boxes
create_SetCriterion: create a SetCriterion loss module with matcher, weight dict, and loss types for training
compute_SetCriterion_loss: compute detection losses including labels, boxes, cardinality, and masks using SetCriterion forward
run_PostProcess: run PostProcess to convert DETR output logits and boxes into scored detection results
